name: Yukusasa Honeybell
source:
A second-year student at St.Trea Academy. A member of the board game club, she is a returnee born to an American father and a Japanese mother.

She is lovely, both in appearance and personality. She is good at housework and is very feminine. Having grown up in the U.S. for a long time, she has a desire to know more of Japanese culture. 

She can experience Japanese board games as a member of the board game club.

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/shangrila/chartop.html]official site[/url]]

•[b]Boob Shape[/b]
[b]Cone shaped (Torpedo Boobs)[/b]
